senses.gloss: (v. סוט; cmp. זוּל I a. זָלַל) to be extravagant, squander.
units: Targ. Prov. XXIII, 20 דאֲסִיטוּן וכ׳ (Ms. דאֲסִיטִין, v. infra) who are extravagant in eating meat, v. זוּל I.—Part. אָסֵיט extravagant.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:21">Ib. 21</cite>.—Pl. <he>אֲסִיטִין</he>, v. supra.
